files.content:
# Pixel Dice Poker

A small offline dice game made with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No packages, server, external assets, or network connection are needed.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a browser. Select **Roll dice** for your opening roll, then click or keyboard-activate dice to hold them. Roll up to two more times. Your hand is shown after each roll; the round ends after the second reroll. Select **New round** to start over.

The game recognizes pair, two pair, three of a kind, straight, full house, four of a kind, and five of a kind. A hand with none of those combinations is shown as **High dice**. The ace-low straight (1–2–3–4–6) is not included; valid straights are 1–5 and 2–6.

Dice controls support Tab, Enter, and Space. A held die is exposed as pressed to assistive technology.
